plan.tag: [Biking and Rolling Plan, March 2025, North Star map — traced 2026-09-29]
plan.milesUnit: per direction of travel, as the plan's 472 miles (printed p. 20) are counted, times the share of each block the plan draws

directions.rule: A plan block's miles are the block's miles per direction of travel, times the part of it the plan draws where the plan's line stops partway along it: the sum of its bikeway layer rows' own lengths where the layer carries it, else its centerline length once where the street centerline's oneway flag is F or T, else twice.
